BiblicalUsage: Hachaliah is named twice, both times as the father of Nehemiah — the words of Nehemiah the son of Hachaliah open the book, and his name stands among those who sealed the covenant. Two mentions, and both are about his son.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe a father is remembered by his son's work, and Hachaliah's son rebuilt a wall and a people.
